This is a Member-State implementation requirement; national law and ABC Shield applicability need review.
Notes: Official EUR-Lex excerpt from Article 13(1). This provision directs Member States to provide legal-person liability under specified conditions; it is not by itself a complete directly applicable ABC Shield rule. Check national transposition and entity/jurisdiction scope. Pending SME validation.

title: Mitigating circumstances
text:
Source: EU-01 - Directive (EU) 2026/1021 on combatting corruption
Reference: Article 16
Topic: Mitigating circumstances
Requirement: Article 16 identifies certain circumstances that national law can treat as mitigating, including effective internal controls, ethics awareness and compliance programmes for a legal person, and rapid voluntary disclosure plus remedial measures. It is a mitigation framework, not a guarantee of reduced liability or a standalone firm-level duty.
Notes: Official EUR-Lex excerpt from Article 16(c). Article 16 requires Member States to ensure specified circumstances may be treated as mitigating under national law; points (c) and (d) apply only to legal persons. Not a standalone direct ABC Shield duty. Pending SME validation.
